facts.fact: ZRA, UNCTAD and TradeMark Africa signed an agreement on 16 December 2025 for an 18-month, UK-funded project to upgrade and stabilise the ASYCUDAWorld customs system.
ZRA Commissioner General Dingani Banda said ASYCUDA is deeply integrated with internal and external systems and is handling rising declaration volumes, with delays at borders.
A British High Commission official said the upgraded ASYCUDA Single Window will improve coordination across agencies and shorten clearance times.
